question: Which Indian state has announced plans to build a ‘Great Green Wall’ by 2030 to protect its coastline from cyclones and environmental degradation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The government of **Andhra Pradesh** has proposed the development of a **‘Great Green Wall’** along its coastline, aimed for completion by the **year 2030**.
 
• The initiative is designed to act as a **natural biological shield** to protect the state's coastal districts from the devastating impacts of **cyclones**, **high-tide surges**, and **tsunamis**.
 
• The project focuses on the extensive planting of **mangroves** and **shelterbelt plantations** (such as **casuarina** trees) along the **974 km** long coastline, which is the **second-longest** in mainland **India**.
 
• This green belt is expected to prevent **coastal erosion** and mitigate **environmental degradation** caused by climate change and industrial activities near the shore. ***Hence, the correct answer is Andhra Pradesh.***
